name: Cena Marella
description: Admiral of the Royal Naval Fleet - early riser, late socializer

default.activity: at the harbor or aboard the flagship
default.return_message: *walks in smelling like salt air and confidence* Miss me?

default_return_message: *strides back in with a grin* The fleet's good. What's happening here?
manual_away_message: *stretches and grabs his coat* Ships don't inspect themselves. Back in a bit. *heads toward the docks*

entries.away_message: Sunrise from the deck. Best part of the day. Don't wait up.

entries.activity: morning fleet inspection and harbor rounds
at The Barracks or the harbor tavern

entries.away_message: Early tide tomorrow. The sea waits for no one. *heads out*
